duas.dua_english: Dhahabaẓ-ẓama', wabtallati 'l-urūq, wa thabata 'l-'ajru in shā Allāh
duas.dua_english_translation: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.dua_arabic: ذَهَـبَ الظَّمَـأُ، وَابْتَلَّـتِ العُـروق، وَثَبَـتَ الأجْـرُ إِنْ شـاءَ الله

duas.dua_english: Allāhumma innī as'aluka bi raḥmatika 'l-latī wasi'at kulla shay' an taghfira lī
duas.dua_english_translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.
duas.dua_arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ بِرَحْمَـتِكَ الّتي وَسِـعَت كُلَّ شيء، أَنْ تَغْـفِرَ لي
sources: Ibn Majah 1/557 from a supplication of Abdullah bin 'Amr
Al-Hafidh graded it as good in his checking of An-Nawawi's Kitabul-'Athkdr
